items.headline: Apple officer discloses sale under a trading plan
items.reason: SEC Form 4 and acceptance time verify the November 3 sale, 2,399 shares, $325.75 price, 29,997 directly held and May 5 trading plan. Public Apple-specific disclosure; no investment-view or price-causation inference.

items.headline: IREN discloses Microsoft-requested network changes and revised deployment timing
items.reason: IREN release and 10-Q verify Microsoft-requested Horizon changes, limited delay-credit relief, ongoing fee discussions and revised ARR timing. Direct Microsoft capacity relevance; counterparty attribution, ARR caveat and Horizon 1 acceptance retained.

items.headline: NVIDIA promotes Vera CPU agent performance and power efficiency
items.reason: Issuer article and datePublished metadata verify Vera comparisons and planned Perplexity use. NVIDIA-specific product research; vendor-selected benchmarks are attributed and distinguished from independent validation or revenue guidance.

items.headline: Alphabet closes €6 billion senior-note offering
items.reason: SEC 8-K and acceptance time verify the November 5 EUR 6 billion closing, seven tranches, 2028–2045 maturities and fixed-coupon range. Alphabet-specific financing, clearly separate from an earnings outlook.

items.headline: Meta completes $15 billion debt offering and expands forward equity sale
items.reason: SEC 8-K and acceptance time verify the USD 15 billion debt completion and November 4 full option exercise for six million forward shares. Meta-specific financing; closing versus pricing and potential issuance versus immediate cash remain distinct.

items.headline: Micron announces director retirement
items.reason: SEC 8-K and Exhibit 99.1 verify Haynesworth retirement, expected January 14 meeting and eight remaining directors. Micron-specific governance with the expected-date qualification and no operating-guidance or price-causation claim.
